status: emitted by the game (src/world/moments.ts and games/sailing/main.ts), except: gybe_controlled, gybe_uncontrolled, capsize, gust, wind_shift, near_vessel, timer_warning, timer_end

moments.when: mission starts
tack_side changes with the wind passing the bow
tack_side changes with the wind passing the stern
gybe with sheets at most 0.5 as the stern crosses
gybe with sheets above 0.5
point_of_sail in_irons and u < 0.5 m/s for 3 s
after enter_irons: abs(twa_deg) > 45 and u > 0.8 m/s
luffing_fraction > 0.5 for 5 s on a steady heading
luffing_fraction < 0.2 for 3 s after luffing_start
heel over 0.45 rad (26°), as the instruments warn
heel_ratio >= 1
true wind speed up 30 % within 5 s
true wind direction moves 10° within 5 s
point_of_sail band changes and holds 5 s
heading within 10° and point_of_sail unchanged for 20 s
another boat within 3 boat lengths or time_to_contact < 15 s
collision reported by the mission
aground flag set
aground flag cleared
distance_to_target under 300 m (again for each new goal)
mission goal reached (dock, mark, buoy rounded, alongside, catch)
15 s left on a timed task
time limit reached
mission over, any outcome
whale surfaces
within 22 m of the whale from astern
whale sees the boat and dives
whale dives after breathing, or mission ends
muleta switches to lateral fishing
the catch passes half the target (the net is filling)
within 35 m of the boat at anchor and under 1.5 kn
seaweed or rubbish picked up
the boat passes within 800 m of a named place; written near_place:<name>
